summary: Excellent wireframe specification for the High Council UI. The document comprehensively covers all major Council scenarios including: opening ceremony, candidate nomination, AI voting animations, player voting (both as candidate and non-candidate), vote tallies, victory/defeat screens, defiance mechanics (Final War), pre-council lobbying, and bribery dialogs. The wireframes are detailed ASCII layouts matching the established format from other UI specs. The document correctly implements MOO1 mechanics (50% colonization trigger, 25-turn intervals, 2/3 majority requirement, candidate selection by population, abstention rules). Pet-themed lore is properly integrated with race names (Hamsters, Guinea Pigs, Rats, etc.). JSON data structures are valid and well-defined. Edge cases are thoroughly documented. State transitions are clearly diagrammed. Minor issues found are cosmetic/formatting only.
